title: Parsons invokes Bartzabel against Hubbard
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Parsons invokes Bartzabel against Hubbard, about 1946 at Miami hotel room, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Parsons, furious, attempted a magical counterattack, invoking the spirit of Mars, Bartzabel, in a Miami hotel room.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story from 1946 about Jack Parsons, an early American rocket pioneer who also practised ritual magic, and L. Ron Hubbard, later the founder of Scientology. Michels says that Parsons, furious with Hubbard, tried a magical counterattack in a Miami hotel room by calling on Bartzabel, which Michels describes as the spirit of Mars. He tells it to show how closely early rocketry and the occult were tangled together.
